title: Colours
description: Describe and choose things by colour.

questions.sentence: Akasher rong ki?
options: Akash nil.
Akash lal.
Akash holud.
questions.correctAnswer: Akash nil.

questions.sentence: Ei ful ta lal.
options: This flower is red.
This flower is yellow.
That flower is red.
questions.correctAnswer: This flower is red.

questions.sentence: Ghaser rong ki?
options: Ghas sabuj.
Ghas kalo.
Ghas golapi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ghas sabuj.

questions.sentence: Amar juta kalo.
options: My shoes are black.
My shoes are brown.
My shirt is black.
questions.correctAnswer: My shoes are black.

questions.sentence: Tomar priyo rong ki?
options: Amar priyo rong nil.
Amar priyo rong kalo.
Amar priyo rong sabuj.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar priyo rong nil.

questions.sentence: Dudh shada hoy.
options: Milk is white.
Milk is sweet.
Rice is white.
questions.correctAnswer: Milk is white.

questions.sentence: Ei kola ta ki holud?
options: Hyan, eta holud.
Na, eta nil.
Na, eta kalo.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan, eta holud.

questions.sentence: Chayer rong badami.
options: Tea is brown in colour.
The tea is very hot.
Tea is black in colour.
questions.correctAnswer: Tea is brown in colour.

questions.sentence: Ei gach ta ki sabuj?
options: Hyan, gach ta sabuj.
Na, gach ta shada.
Na, gach ta lal.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan, gach ta sabuj.

questions.sentence: Tomar bag ta kon ronger?
options: Amar bag ta komla ronger.
Amar bag ta beguni ronger.
Amar bag ta shada ronger.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar bag ta komla ronger.

questions.sentence: Amar chhata ta kalo ronger.
options: My umbrella is black.
My umbrella is blue.
Her umbrella is black.
questions.correctAnswer: My umbrella is black.

questions.sentence: Ei chair gulo kon ronger?
options: Ei chair gulo lal ronger.
Ei chair gulo holud ronger.
Ei chair gulo sabuj ronger.
questions.correctAnswer: Ei chair gulo lal ronger.

questions.sentence: Amader barir darja ta sabuj.
options: The door of our house is green.
The door of our house is blue.
The window of our house is green.
questions.correctAnswer: The door of our house is green.

questions.sentence: Tomar phone tar rong ki?
options: Amar phone ta shada.
Amar phone ta golapi.
Amar phone ta badami.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar phone ta shada.

questions.sentence: Ei kolom ta nil, oi ta kalo.
options: This pen is blue and that one is black.
This pen is black and that one is blue.
This pen is blue and that one is red.
questions.correctAnswer: This pen is blue and that one is black.

questions.sentence: Ei bari ta ki holud ronger?
options: Hyan, bari ta holud ronger.
Na, bari ta gaaro nil ronger.
Na, bari ta shada ronger.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan, bari ta holud ronger.

questions.sentence: Tram gulo holud ronger hoy.
options: The trams are yellow.
The buses are yellow.
The trams are green.
questions.correctAnswer: The trams are yellow.

questions.sentence: Apnar gari ta kon ronger?
options: Amar gari ta kalo ronger.
Amar gari ta lal ronger.
Amar gari ta sabuj ronger.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar gari ta kalo ronger.

questions.sentence: Apni kon ronger jama chan?
options: Ami nil ronger jama chai.
Ami lal ronger jama chai.
Ami kalo ronger jama chai.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami nil ronger jama chai.

questions.sentence: Amar ekta shada shari chai.
options: I want a white saree.
I want a white shirt.
I do not want a white saree.
questions.correctAnswer: I want a white saree.

questions.sentence: Ei ronger juta ki apnar pochondo?
options: Hyan, ei rong ta amar pochondo.
Na, ei rong ta amar pochondo na.
Ami juta khunjchhi na.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan, ei rong ta amar pochondo.

questions.sentence: Golapi ronger ta ektu dekhan.
options: Please show me the pink one.
Please show me the purple one.
Please give me the pink one.
questions.correctAnswer: Please show me the pink one.

questions.sentence: Apnar kache ki komla ronger chhata ache?
options: Na, komla ronger nei, kintu sabuj ache.
Hyan, komla ronger onek ache.
Amra chhata bikri kori na.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, komla ronger nei, kintu sabuj ache.
questions.translatedSentence: No, we do not have orange, but we have green.

questions.sentence: Ami holud rong ta pochondo kori na.
options: I do not like the colour yellow.
I really like the colour yellow.
I do not like the colour orange.
questions.correctAnswer: I do not like the colour yellow.

questions.sentence: Tumi kon rong ta nebe?
options: Ami beguni ta nebo.
Ami nil ta nebo.
Ami ekhon kichhu nebo na.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami beguni ta nebo.
questions.translatedSentence: I will take the purple one.

questions.sentence: Ei lal jama tar dam koto?
options: How much does this red shirt cost?
How much does this blue shirt cost?
Where can I find this red shirt?
questions.correctAnswer: How much does this red shirt cost?

questions.sentence: Apni ki aro rong dekhte chan?
options: Na, ei rong tai thik ache.
Hyan, aro kichhu rong dekhan.
Ami ekhoni bari jachhi.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, ei rong tai thik ache.

questions.sentence: Aaj tumi kon ronger jama porecho?
options: Ami aaj sabuj jama porechi.
Ami aaj lal shari porechi.
Ami aaj nil panjabi porechi.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami aaj sabuj jama porechi.
questions.translatedSentence: Today I am wearing a green shirt.

questions.sentence: Biyer din o lal shari porechhilo.
options: She wore a red saree on the wedding day.
She will wear a red saree on the wedding day.
She wore a red shirt on the wedding day.
questions.correctAnswer: She wore a red saree on the wedding day.

questions.sentence: Ei kalo panjabi ta ki tomar?
options: Na, oi ta amar dadar.
Hyan, oi ta amar dadar.
Na, ami panjabi pori na.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, oi ta amar dadar.
questions.translatedSentence: No, that one is my elder brother's.

questions.sentence: Amar shada juta gulo nongra hoye gechhe.
options: My white shoes have got dirty.
My black shoes have got dirty.
My white shoes have got torn.
questions.correctAnswer: My white shoes have got dirty.

questions.sentence: Apnar chhele kon ronger jama pochondo kore?
options: O sabsomoy kalo pochondo kore.
O sabsomoy holud pochondo kore.
O rong niye kichhu bole na.
questions.correctAnswer: O sabsomoy kalo pochondo kore.

questions.sentence: Sitkale ami gaaro ronger jama pori.
options: In winter I wear dark-coloured clothes.
In summer I wear dark-coloured clothes.
In winter I wear light-coloured clothes.
questions.correctAnswer: In winter I wear dark-coloured clothes.

questions.sentence: Ei halka golapi jama ta ki tomar bhalo lagchhe?
options: Na, amar gaaro rong beshi bhalo lage.
Hyan, amar halka rong kokhono bhalo lage na.
Na, ami golapi jama kine felechi.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, amar gaaro rong beshi bhalo lage.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I like dark colours more.

questions.sentence: Puja te ami notun holud shari kinbo.
options: For the puja I will buy a new yellow saree.
For the puja I bought a new yellow saree.
For the puja I will buy a new yellow shirt.
questions.correctAnswer: For the puja I will buy a new yellow saree.

questions.sentence: Tomar bon ki nil ronger jama porte bhalobashe?
options: Na, o beshir bhag somoy shada pore.
Hyan, o nil chhara onno kichhu pore na.
Na, o lal ronger juta pochondo kore.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, o beshir bhag somoy shada pore.

questions.sentence: Brishtir por akash kemon dekhay?
options: Brishtir por akash porishkar nil hoye jay.
Brishtir por akash sara din kalo thake.
Brishtir por akash gaaro lal hoye jay.
questions.correctAnswer: Brishtir por akash porishkar nil hoye jay.
questions.translatedSentence: After the rain the sky turns a clear blue.

questions.sentence: Howrah bridge ta dur theke dhusor dekhay.
options: The Howrah bridge looks grey from a distance.
The Howrah bridge looks white from a distance.
The Howrah bridge looks grey from close up.
questions.correctAnswer: The Howrah bridge looks grey from a distance.

questions.sentence: Metror ei line ta kon ronger?
options: Ei line ta nil ronger.
Ei line ta sabuj ronger.
Ei line ta beguni ronger.
questions.correctAnswer: Ei line ta nil ronger.
questions.translatedSentence: This line is the blue one.

questions.sentence: Sondhyay Gangar jol komla dekhay.
options: In the evening the water of the Ganga looks orange.
In the morning the water of the Ganga looks orange.
In the evening the water of the Ganga looks black.
questions.correctAnswer: In the evening the water of the Ganga looks orange.

questions.sentence: Sitkale gacher pata gulo ki sabuj thake?
options: Na, pata gulo holud hoye jay.
Hyan, pata gulo sara bochor sabuj thake.
Na, pata gulo tokhon nil hoye jay.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, pata gulo holud hoye jay.

questions.sentence: Amader parar dokan gulo sabuj rong kora.
options: The shops in our neighbourhood are painted green.
The shops in our neighbourhood are painted blue.
The houses in our neighbourhood are painted green.
questions.correctAnswer: The shops in our neighbourhood are painted green.

questions.sentence: Kolkatar tram gulo ki ekhono holud?
options: Hyan, ekhono holud ronger tram chole.
Na, ekhon sob tram nil ronger.
Hyan, kintu tram gulo ekhon sabuj.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan, ekhono holud ronger tram chole.

questions.sentence: Macher jhol e holud diye rong ana hoy.
options: Turmeric gives the fish curry its colour.
Chilli gives the fish curry its colour.
Turmeric gives the fish curry its smell.
questions.correctAnswer: Turmeric gives the fish curry its colour.

questions.sentence: Mishtir dokane kon ronger mishti beshi dekha jay?
options: Sekhane shada ar badami mishti beshi thake.
Sekhane sudhu nil ronger mishti pawa jay.
Sekhane kalo ronger mishti beshi bikri hoy.
questions.correctAnswer: Sekhane shada ar badami mishti beshi thake.
questions.translatedSentence: White and brown sweets are the most common there.

questions.sentence: Apnar ki gaaro nil bhalo lage, na halka nil?
options: Amar gaaro nil beshi bhalo lage, karon ta porishkar dekhay.
Amar halka nil beshi bhalo lage, karon ta thanda dekhay.
Amar duto rong i kharap lage, tai ami kalo pori.
questions.correctAnswer: Amar gaaro nil beshi bhalo lage, karon ta porishkar dekhay.
questions.translatedSentence: I like dark blue more, because it looks neat.

questions.sentence: Ei lal ta oi lal tar cheye ektu gaaro.
options: This red is a little darker than that one.
This red is a little lighter than that one.
That red is a little darker than this one.
questions.correctAnswer: This red is a little darker than that one.

questions.sentence: Ei shari tar rong ta ki amake manabe?
options: Hyan, ei rong ta apnake khub bhalo manabe.
Na, ei rong ta apnake manabe na, halka kichhu dekhun.
Hyan, kintu ei rong ta ekhon pawa jachhe na.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan, ei rong ta apnake khub bhalo manabe.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, this colour will suit you very well.

questions.sentence: Jodi halka rong ta thake, tahole ami oi ta i nebo.
options: If you have the lighter colour, I will take that one.
If you have the darker colour, I will take that one.
If you have the lighter colour, I will not take it.
questions.correctAnswer: If you have the lighter colour, I will take that one.

questions.sentence: Tumi ki oi kalo jama ta kinbe?
options: Na, kinbo na, karon amar onek kalo jama ache.
Hyan, kinbo, karon amar ekta o kalo jama nei.
Na, kinbo na, karon kalo rong ta ekhane nei.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, kinbo na, karon amar onek kalo jama ache.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I will not, because I already have plenty of black clothes.

questions.sentence: Amar sabuj bhalo lage, kintu ei sabuj ta beshi ujjol.
options: I like green, but this green is too bright.
I like green, but this green is too dark.
I do not like green, and this green is too bright.
questions.correctAnswer: I like green, but this green is too bright.

questions.sentence: Apni ki ei rong ta bodle onno kichhu dekhte chan?
options: Hyan, ektu halka ronger kichhu dekhan.
Na, ei rong tai amar sob theke bhalo lagchhe.
Hyan, kintu ami aaj kichhu kinbo na.
questions.correctAnswer: Hyan, ektu halka ronger kichhu dekhan.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, please show me something in a lighter colour.

questions.sentence: Garame halka ronger jama porle aram lage.
options: Wearing light-coloured clothes feels comfortable in summer.
Wearing dark-coloured clothes feels comfortable in summer.
Wearing light-coloured clothes feels comfortable in winter.
questions.correctAnswer: Wearing light-coloured clothes feels comfortable in summer.

questions.sentence: Tomar didir biye te tumi kon rong porbe?
options: Ami gaaro lal porbo, karon didi lal bhalobashe.
Ami halka golapi porbo, karon ta amake bhalo manay.
Ami kalo porbo, karon amar onno rong nei.
questions.correctAnswer: Ami gaaro lal porbo, karon didi lal bhalobashe.
questions.translatedSentence: I will wear deep red, because my elder sister loves red.
